items.name: audio.speak
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.audio_speak → tts_service (DashScope realtime / DashScope HTTP / fal TTS) → R2 or inline
items.summary: Synchronous text-to-speech. The host resolves the user's preferred TTS model (or your `model` hint), validates `text` length and `voice` against that model's catalogue entry, synthesizes, bills per character and returns either a presigned R2 URL (default) or inline base64 (≤1 MB products). Three provider families are dispatched by the catalogue's `api_type`; knobs a model does not support are ignored, never surcharged.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.audio.speak(args: {text: string, voice?: string, language?: string, speed?: number, format?: 'mp3'|'wav', timestamps?: boolean, delivery?: 'url'|'inline', model?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{url?: string, expiresIn?: number, audioBase64?: string, mimeType: string, charCount: number, billedCostCU: number, model: string}>

params.name: text
params.summary: Text to synthesize. Trimmed; empty → `VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST` (shared validator). Capped by the resolved model's `maxCharsPerCall` (catalogue; e.g. 1000 for Qwen TTS Plus, 2000 for Flash) → `AUDIO_TEXT_TOO_LONG` echoes the cap. Platform content moderation applies (`AUDIO_CONTENT_REJECTED`, not billed).

params.name: voice
params.summary: Voice id from the model's voice table (`llm.catalog({serviceType:'tts'}).models[].capabilities.voices[].id`). Unknown → `AUDIO_VOICE_INVALID` with `data.allowed` = valid voices. Do **not** hard-code voices — they differ per model (Cherry/Serena… on Qwen, Rachel… on ElevenLabs, Wise_Woman… on MiniMax).

params.name: language
params.summary: Language hint mapped per provider (`language_code` / `language_boost` / `language`); DashScope auto-detects.

params.name: speed
params.summary: Speaking rate 0.5–2.0 (outside → `VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST`). Ignored by models without a speed knob (ElevenLabs, xAI).

params.name: format
params.summary: `mp3` (`audio/mpeg`) or `wav` (`audio/wav`).

params.name: timestamps
params.summary: Request word-level timestamps (subtitle alignment). Only ElevenLabs eleven-v3 honours it; others ignore.

params.name: delivery
params.summary: `url` → bytes stored on R2, presigned GET returned (`expiresIn` ~1800s). `inline` → `audioBase64` in the response when the product is ≤1 MB (larger products fall back to `url`).

params.name: model
params.summary: Optional TTS model hint (`modelName` from `llm.catalog`). Unknown / not routable → `AUDIO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`.

returns.type: { url?: string, expiresIn?: number, audioBase64?: string, mimeType: string, charCount: number, billedCostCU: number, model: string }
returns.desc: Either `url` (+`expiresIn`) or `audioBase64` depending on `delivery` and size. `model` tells you which catalogue model actually spoke (label it in your UI). `charCount` is the billed length.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.audio` does not list this operation, or the user's `media_grant.audio.enabled` / per-operation flag (`speak` or `transcribe`) is off for this App.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User plan CU quota exhausted (HTTP 429 on the HTTP surface).

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Empty `text`, bad `format` / `delivery`, `speed` outside 0.5–2.0 (validation code shared with the video surface).

errors.name: AUDIO_TEXT_TOO_LONG
errors.desc: `text` exceeds the model's `maxCharsPerCall`; `data.allowed.maxCharsPerCall` echoes the cap.

errors.name: AUDIO_VOICE_INVALID
errors.desc: `voice` not in the resolved model's voice table; `data.allowed` lists valid voices.

errors.name: AUDIO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No text-to-speech model routable or unknown `model` hint.

errors.name: AUDIO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Provider call failed (message carries the first 200 chars). HTTP 502 underneath.

errors.name: AUDIO_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: Platform moderation rejected the text. Not billed.

billing.model: per character (`pricing.unit = per_10k_chars` → CU, minimum 1 CU), charged after a successful synthesis

limitations: Synchronous with a 120s HTTP timeout — split long narration into sentences; quality-tier models (Qwen TTS Plus) synthesize ~16 chars/s.
No streaming / sentence-level chunking on the sync surface. For streaming TTS with barge-in open a realtime `anna.audio.session()` and use `say()`.
Presigned URLs expire in ~30 min; persist via `upload.*` if needed.
`speak` will never change to return a `jobId` — a future long-form API would be a separate `audio.speakAsync`.

items.name: audio.transcribe
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.audio_transcribe → LLMRouter (ServiceType.STT) → OpenAI-compatible chat/completions with input_audio
items.summary: Synchronous speech-to-text for a whole recording (≤10 min). Pass the audio inline (base64, ≤10 MB) or as a public `https` URL (≤25 MB). The host routes to the user's preferred speech-to-text model, returns the transcript and bills per audio second.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.audio.transcribe(args: {audioUrl?: string, audioBase64?: string, format?: 'wav'|'mp3'|'webm'|'ogg'|'flac'|'m4a', language?: string, model?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{text: string, language: string, billedCostCU: number}>

params.name: audioUrl
params.summary: Public `https` URL of the recording (SSRF guard applies). Fetched server-side, ≤25 MB → `AUDIO_TOO_LONG`. Format inferred from content-type / extension.

params.name: audioBase64
params.summary: Inline recording, base64, decoded size ≤10 MB. Provide `format` when inline.

params.name: format
params.summary: Container of the inline audio: `wav` / `mp3` / `webm` / `ogg` / `flac` / `m4a` (`mpeg`/`mpga` → mp3). Browser `MediaRecorder` typically yields `webm`.

params.name: language
params.summary: ISO 639-1 hint (`zh`, `en`, …). Echoed back in the response.

params.name: model
params.summary: Optional STT model hint.

returns.type: { text: string, language: string, billedCostCU: number }
returns.desc: `text` is the verbatim transcript (no diarization, no timestamps on this surface).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.audio` does not list this operation, or the user's `media_grant.audio.enabled` / per-operation flag (`speak` or `transcribe`) is off for this App.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User plan CU quota exhausted (HTTP 429 on the HTTP surface).

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Neither / both of `audioUrl` and `audioBase64`, bad base64, bad URL, unsupported `format`.

errors.name: AUDIO_TOO_LONG
errors.desc: Recording longer than 10 min or larger than 25 MB (URL) / 10 MB (inline).

errors.name: AUDIO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No speech-to-text model routable.

errors.name: AUDIO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: STT provider failed (message carries the first 200 chars).

billing.model: per audio second of the routed model (token-priced models are converted), charged after a successful transcription

limitations: Whole-file, synchronous recognition only. For live / streaming ASR (partial results, barge-in) open a realtime `anna.audio.session()`.
10 min / 25 MB / 10 MB caps are hard; split long recordings client-side.
Inline payloads travel through postMessage + JSON — prefer `audioUrl` (e.g. an `upload.*` product) for recordings over a few MB.

items.name: audio.session
items.kind: Host API surface · iframe → host bridge relay (not a dispatcher RPC)
items.since: Introduced anna-app-runtime v0.21.0 / nexus 1.1.0-beta.189 (2026-10-12); documented with schema 0.27.0 (2026-10-14). Not part of `host_api/methods.json` — relayed locally by the host bridge.
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → postMessage `audio.session.*` → host bridge → WS /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/voice → VoiceGateway (streaming ASR → LLMBackend[AppAgent | None] → streaming TTS) → WS events → bridge event `audio.session` → VoiceSession handle
items.summary: Full-duplex realtime voice session for an App: stream 16 kHz PCM16 microphone audio up, receive streaming ASR partials/finals, the LLM's streaming reply (your App's agent session, or no LLM at all) and streaming TTS audio down, with barge-in. Two App-specific primitives: `setContext(text)` injects live App state (≤4 KB) into the **next** turn's system prompt (never into history), and `say(text)` speaks arbitrary text through the same streaming TTS without an LLM round-trip. The bundle never holds a token; the host page owns the socket.

wire.json_rpc_method: audio.session.open · audio.session.send · audio.session.flush · audio.session.context · audio.session.say · audio.session.interrupt · audio.session.close (bridge-local; never forwarded to /runtime/rpc)
wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees a token and opens no network connection. Unlike the other `audio.*` rows this is **not** a dispatcher RPC: `audio.session.*` requests are intercepted by the host bridge (`anna-app-host-bridge.js`, or the anna-mobile shell) which owns the WebSocket `wss://{host}/api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/voice?window_uuid=…` (cookie-authenticated — web session or the mobile shell's scoped `anna_mobile_rt`), checks the window slot, relays messages both ways and tears the socket down when the window closes or the iframe reloads. Hosts without the relay answer `unknown_method` / `not_supported`.
wire.http_equivalent: WS /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/voice?window_uuid=<uuid> (host-bridge only; the main-chat equivalent is WS /api/v1/copilot/voice)

params.name: llm
params.summary: `agent` routes each final utterance through **this App's agent session** (`POST /copilot/app/agent`, server-minted token; tool surface = `ui.host_api.agent.tools`). `none` runs ASR + TTS only — you get `asr_*` events and can `say()` your own text.
notes: `agent` requires manifest `host_api.agent.session.{auto|fixed}` matching `submode`; otherwise the open fails with `permission_denied`.

params.name: submode
params.summary: Same semantics as `anna.agent.session()`; `fixed` needs `fixed_client_id`.

params.name: voice
params.summary: TTS voice id. Must belong to the resolved TTS model's voice table (see `llm.catalog({serviceType:'tts'})`); unknown voices fall back to the model default — the effective voice is echoed in `vs.models.voice`.
notes: Apps cannot pick ASR/TTS **models** — the user's realtime-model preferences apply.

params.name: language
params.summary: ASR language hint (`zh`, `en`, …).

params.name: speed
params.summary: TTS speed; ignored by models without a speed knob.

params.name: context
params.summary: Initial live context (≤4 KB). Same semantics as `setContext()`.

params.name: system
params.summary: System prompt for `llm:'agent'` (≤8 KB). The live context is appended to it inside a `<live_context>` fence on every run; neither enters the conversation history.
notes: Over the cap → `system_too_large` and the open fails.

params.name: maxDurationSec
params.summary: Requested session lifetime; clamped to the host cap (3 h). The effective value is returned as `vs.maxDurationSec`. On expiry the host sends `error{code:'session_timeout'}` then `ended` — reopen if needed.

returns.desc: Resolves once the host's `session_started` arrives (`sessionId`, `audioConfig` = 24 kHz mono PCM16 for the player, `models` = resolved ASR/TTS/voice, `maxDurationSec`, `asrIdleTimeoutSec`). Events: `asr_partial{text}` · `asr_final{text}` · `llm_start{user_text}` · `llm_partial{text}` · `llm_done{text}` · `tts_audio{audio: base64 PCM}` · `tts_done` · `interrupted{source:'barge_in'|'say'}` (not emitted for your own `interrupt()` — stop the player yourself) · `say_start{say_id, chars}` · `say_done{say_id, status:'done'|'interrupted'|'replaced'|'error'}` · `context_updated{chars}` · `asr_paused{idle_sec | reason:'flushed'|'connection_ended'}` · `asr_resumed{reconnect_ms}` · `quota_warning{message}` · `error{code, message}` · `ended{duration, total_asr_seconds, total_tts_characters, reason}`. Unknown event types are dropped (forward-compatible).

errors.name: permission_denied
errors.desc: Window not yours / not active, manifest `ui.host_api.audio` lacks `session`, or `llm:'agent'` without a matching `host_api.agent.session` submode.

errors.name: not_granted
errors.desc: User `media_grant.audio` is off, or one of the `speak` / `transcribe` flags is off — the session needs **both**.

errors.name: concurrency_limit
errors.desc: A voice session is already open for this window (one per window, enforced in the bridge and server-side). No per-user cap.

errors.name: not_supported
errors.desc: Host has the feature flag off (`ANNA_APP_VOICE_SESSION_ENABLED=false`) or the page has no WebSocket.

errors.name: quota_exhausted
errors.desc: CU pool empty at open or during the 60 s periodic check (preceded by `quota_warning`).

errors.name: asr_not_available / tts_not_available
errors.desc: No realtime ASR / TTS model routable for this user.

errors.name: invalid_request
errors.desc: Bad `llm` value, empty `say.text`, or a message before `start_session`.

errors.name: context_too_large / system_too_large / say_too_long
errors.desc: `context` >4 KB, `system` >8 KB, `say.text` >1000 chars. The SDK rejects `setContext` / `say` client-side with the same codes before sending.

errors.name: session_timeout
errors.desc: `maxDurationSec` reached; the session ends right after this error.

errors.name: asr_error / tts_error / tts_peer_closed / tts_upstream_error / llm_timeout / processing_error
errors.desc: Provider-side failures during a turn. The session usually stays open — the next utterance starts fresh.

errors.name: internal_error
errors.desc: Unexpected server failure; the socket closes with 1011 and `ended` fires.

errors.name: timeout / network / closed (bridge)
errors.desc: Bridge-level: no `session_started` within 15 s, socket error, or the window slot was torn down while opening.

billing.request_type: APP_STT (per recognised audio second) · APP_TTS (per synthesised character, replies and `say()` alike)
billing.model: The user's realtime ASR / TTS preferences; `llm:'agent'` turns are billed by the agent session itself (not double-counted).
billing.pricing: Only audio you actually `sendAudio()` is recognised and billed — an idle open session costs nothing. Gate the microphone behind push-to-talk or a wake word; `end()` returns `{total_asr_seconds, total_tts_characters}` for your own accounting.

limitations: Not a dispatcher RPC — requires a host page with the bridge relay (nexus ≥ 1.1.0-beta.189; the local harness mocks it with `SpeechRecognition` / `speechSynthesis`). Hosts without it reply `unknown_method` / `not_supported`.

Upstream audio must be 16 kHz mono PCM16; chunks ≤32 KB (the SDK splits). `sendAudio` is fire-and-forget: when the host socket buffers >256 KB the bridge drops the newest chunks (counted in the bridge's `session.close` reply, not surfaced by `end()`).

ASR connections are paused after `asrIdleTimeoutSec` (15 s) without audio and rebuilt on the next frame (`asr_paused` / `asr_resumed`, ~0.3–0.6 s). Call `flushAudio()` when the user releases push-to-talk — streaming ASR only finalizes after trailing silence frames.

`setContext` is replace-only and applies from the **next** utterance. The composed per-run system prompt (your `system` + the `<live_context>` fence) is validated like any App system prompt — boundary-forging tokens (`<system>`, `<safety`, `<app_system_prompt>`, `system:`) fail the turn with `processing_error` — and html-escaped by the agent builder, so markup in your context is inert; never put instructions the user cannot see in it. `say` has a single pending slot server-side (`normal` queues one; a newer one replaces it → `say_done{status:'replaced'}`); any interruption drops the pending say.
One session per window; no per-user cap. Session lifetime ≤3 h. Apps cannot choose ASR/TTS models (user preferences apply); `vad.silenceMs` is not configurable.

Mobile (anna-mobile shell): foreground-only — WKWebView suspends `getUserMedia` in the background; listen to `host.app_state` and pause/end the session. Android requires a development build (Expo Go cannot grant the WebView microphone).
Agent-session idle TTL is 30 min: after a long silence the next turn transparently re-creates the agent session (history resets; `context` is unaffected).

items.name: audio.mic
items.kind: SDK client helper · pure browser (no host round-trip)
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia` → AudioWorklet (16 kHz PCM16; ScriptProcessor fallback under the production CSP) → `onChunk`
items.summary: Microphone capture tuned for `audio.session`: 16 kHz mono PCM16 frames of 4096 samples (~256 ms) delivered to `onChunk(pcm16, float32)`, with `onLevel(rms)` for a VU meter / cheap VAD, an `analyser` node for visualizers, `setMuted()` as the push-to-talk gate and `stop()` to release the device. Shares one source file with the main-chat voice call (`anna-voice-client-core.js`).

wire.auth: None — runs entirely inside the iframe. Needs a secure context and the outer iframe's `allow="microphone"`, which the host emits iff manifest `host_api.audio ∋ "session"`.

items.signature:
anna.audio.mic(opts?: {sampleRate?: 16000, frameSize?: 4096, onChunk?: (pcm16: Int16Array, float32: Float32Array) => void, onLevel?: (rms: number) => void, onError?: (e) => void, preferWorklet?: boolean, constraints?: MediaTrackConstraints}) => MicCapture

MicCapture { start(): Promise<MicCapture>; stop(): void; setMuted(bool): void; muted; active; mode: 'worklet'|'script'; analyser: AnalyserNode|null; sampleRate; frameSize }

returns.desc: `start()` rejects with a descriptive error on `insecure context` (http://<lan-ip> dev builds — WebView `navigator.mediaDevices` is [SecureContext]-only), permission denied, or missing API; on failure it releases any stream it already acquired.

limitations: Default constraints enable echo cancellation / noise suppression / AGC — pass `constraints` to override.
AudioWorklet needs `blob:` worker scripts; the production bundle CSP (`script-src 'self'`) blocks it, so capture silently falls back to ScriptProcessor (same frame shape).
Open the mic **before** `anna.audio.session()` so a denied permission does not leave a billed-but-silent session open.

items.name: audio.player
items.kind: SDK client helper · pure browser (no host round-trip)
items.direction: `tts_audio{audio}` base64 PCM16 → jitter buffer (3 chunks) → Web Audio scheduled playback
items.summary: Gapless player for the session's streamed TTS: `enqueue(base64)` on every `tts_audio`, `flush()` on `tts_done` (drain the jitter buffer), `stop()` on `interrupted` (barge-in), `onPlaybackEnd` when the queue runs dry. Same implementation as the main-chat voice call.

wire.auth: None — runs entirely inside the iframe.

items.signature:
anna.audio.player(opts?: {sampleRate?: 24000, channels?: 1, format?: 'pcm', jitterChunks?: 3, onPlaybackEnd?: () => void}) => VoiceAudioPlayer

VoiceAudioPlayer { configure(audioConfig): void; enqueue(base64Audio: string): void; flush(): void; stop(): void; destroy(): void; playing; onPlaybackEnd }

returns.desc: Construct it with `vs.audioConfig.sample_rate` (24 kHz today) or call `player.configure(vs.audioConfig)`.

limitations: The AudioContext is created lazily on the first `enqueue`; on iOS Safari / WKWebView it must follow a user gesture — opening the session from a button click satisfies this.
`stop()` discards buffered audio and does not fire `onPlaybackEnd`; reset your own UI state when handling `interrupted`.
